job_spec.purpose: mtp-fixlat-1011 2026-10-10 (ds-1010 latency audit eff5a6f0a: links AT RISK of the fixed-latency grant bug fixed on seq<->WFC). P2 draft-die link ends at the unchanged rb4 core pins: lane receivers lrx_rtt sized to draft-A stages (lane0 vm->p2 12 / p2->vm 14 D30, lane1 coll->p2 8 / p2->coll 9 D21, OUTPUT_PIPE) + transaction gate (a lane word reaches the core only under the identity of the start the core accepted), start receiver D21, result-row ltx. Replaces plain valid/ready (pfifo S2 in_r, pin_output out_r) over relay stations, which loses / duplicates words (as-is P2 bench FAILs). Gates: tools/mtp_fixlat_gate.py stationed benches (relay stations at the generator counts) + latency-1 / stale / as-is negatives; option B TT>=0 FF>=0 DRC0. Cycles: 0 at full rate for the seq ends; P2 link ends +9 cycles per P2 transaction (measured, tb_mtp_p2_fixlat NOSTALL lnk 6,122 vs direct core 6,113 at 0 stations). | RELAUNCH idle-sweep-1010: c4de433dd failed floorplan PPL-0061 (plan pins name[0] vs scalar RTL ports); ffbec0c86 declares 1-bit ports [0:0]. | p2lnk-1011 rev 2 (c917ea78d): ffbec0c86 NEEDS_RTL TT -280.12 / FF -2.26: c_in_v = valid AND 74-b identity compare -> port (13 lv), c_in_r -> 604-b OUTPUT_PIPE enables (1,208 loads), flop->port wire (c_in_d/t_od/c_start_d), c_start_r -> start state. Fix: gate stage with REGISTERED match flag, core-side ot_sc_pfifo PINREG S3 on both lanes / start / result row (registered in_ready / out_valid, replicated-pointer 3:1 select), registered start accept, result row -> ltx_rc. Gate all PASS/FAIL as expected; +17 cycles per P2 transaction (was +9), p2.link_ends 51, ds_rom_step 4,185.1 tok/s. HM 0.020. | DUAL TRACK with idle-sweep's fixlat-p2lnk-3d7201bc4-tc (main: ltx_rc->lrx D4 pairs, c_in_d still a queue mux at the port, t_od still a single S->N flop); source on branch claude/p2lnk-1011 (main keeps 3d7201bc4 RTL until one closes).
